title: Tanzanian Banana Milkshake
community: Urban Tanzania and banana-growing regions — the most affordable milkshake
author: Mama Salima
desc: Tanzanian Banana Milkshake — ripe Tanzanian bananas blended with cold milk, honey, cardamom, and ice. Thick, sweet, filling, and completely satisfying — the most affordable milkshake in Tanzania, made from the fruit that grows everywhere.
longDesc: Banana milkshake is the drink of Tanzania's student population and young families — affordable, filling, and made from the most available fruit in the country. The cardamom gives it an unmistakably Tanzanian character.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 45—60 seconds until smooth and frothy.
chefTips: Very ripe bananas (with black spots) produce a much sweeter, more flavourful shake.
Frozen bananas make the shake thicker and colder.
cookingScience: Very ripe bananas have converted their starch to sugars via amylase activity — they are naturally sweeter, smoother when blended, and release more of the aromatic esters responsible for banana flavour than less ripe bananas.
sustainabilityTips: Over-ripe bananas that would otherwise go to waste are perfect for milkshakes.
culturalNote: Banana milkshake is Tanzania's most egalitarian drink — made from the cheapest and most available fruit, it can be made by anyone, anywhere, for very little. It is the milkshake that Tanzania's children grow up on.
